help.title: About Contracts & clients
help.overview: Contracts Hub is a company-wide registry of commercial documents that already exist: reservations, sales, and related client files. It does not create a new contract type. Opening a row opens the reservation or sale sheet. Use this page to search across clients and statuses without bouncing between two lists.

sections.title: What you see
items: Rows drawn from Reservations and Sales (and their client, unit, project, dates, amounts, status).
Filters for project, client, status, dates — applied to this registry only.
The same documents you would find under Reservations or Sales, presented together.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: Create, pay, cancel, approve, handover — those actions still live on Reservations and Sales.
Nothing is duplicated in the database. If a reservation disappears from Reservations, it disappears here.
Expired and active reservations can both appear, depending on the hub’s status filter.

sections.title: When to use it
items: Ops asks “what contracts does this client have?” — search here.
When you need to act (collect a deposit, approve a sale), open the row and use the underlying sheet, or go to the dedicated list.

sections.title: Related records
items: Reservation, Sale, Unit, client user. Not leases — those are Rentals Hub / Leases.
